pipeline_json.name: enrollment_silver_ods_identity_load_source_system
pipeline_json.description: Silver raw enrollment -> silver ODS. Merge anchor our_id (+ natural key). link_id carried in record_hash and backfilled (not a match key). member: merge on our_id; children: our_id + natural key (effective tables include start_date). is_active in hash so soft-deletes land as UPDATEs. VARIANT: source_system is part of every table's merge key (per-source rows).

SELECT * FROM (-- CDC: merge on (our_id, source_system); link_id in hash -> backfilled; insert/update only
WITH identity AS (
  SELECT source_system_id, source_system, link_id, our_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY source_system_id, source_system ORDER BY try_cast(batch_id AS bigint) DESC, coalesce(updated_at, created_at) DESC) AS idn_seq
  FROM ${catalog}.${ods_schema}.member_identity_resolution
  WHERE is_active = true AND our_id IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
  SELECT i.our_id, i.link_id, r.source_system_id, r.first_name, r.last_name, r.middle_name, r.suffix, r.date_of_birth, r.gender, r.race, r.ethnicity, r.language, r.location, r.care_management_program, r.last_contact, r.dual_status_code, r.death_date, r.secure_id, r.dnc, r.guardian_first_name, r.guardian_last_name, r.guardian_phone_number, r.guardian_email,
    coalesce(r.is_active, true) AS is_active,
    sha2(concat_ws('||',
      coalesce(trim(cast(i.link_id as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.first_name as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.last_name as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.middle_name as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.suffix as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.date_of_birth as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.gender as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.race as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.ethnicity as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.language as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.location as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.care_management_program as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.last_contact as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.dual_status_code as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.death_date as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.secure_id as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.dnc as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.guardian_first_name as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.guardian_last_name as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.guardian_phone_number as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.guardian_email as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.is_active as string)), '')
    ), 256) AS ods_record_hash,
    r.feed_name, r.source_system, r.member_payor, r.batch_id, r.record_creation_date
  FROM ${catalog}.${raw_schema}.member r
  INNER JOIN identity i
    ON i.source_system_id = r.source_system_id AND i.source_system = r.source_system AND i.idn_seq = 1
  WHERE r.batch_id = ${batch_id}
),
enriched_dedup AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.our_id, e.source_system ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.link_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, e.source_system_id) AS _dedup_seq
    FROM enriched e
  ) WHERE _dedup_seq = 1
),
with_ods AS (
  SELECT e.our_id, e.link_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.middle_name, e.suffix, e.date_of_birth, e.gender, e.race, e.ethnicity, e.language, e.location, e.care_management_program, e.last_contact, e.dual_status_code, e.death_date, e.secure_id, e.dnc, e.guardian_first_name, e.guardian_last_name, e.guardian_phone_number, e.guardian_email,
    e.is_active, e.ods_record_hash AS record_hash, e.feed_name, e.source_system, e.member_payor,
    coalesce(o.record_creation_date, e.record_creation_date, current_timestamp()) AS record_creation_date,
    o.our_id AS previous_our_id,
    'ODS_IDENTITY_PIPELINE' AS created_by, coalesce(o.created_at, current_timestamp()) AS created_at,
    'ODS_IDENTITY_PIPELINE' AS updated_by, current_timestamp() AS updated_at, e.batch_id, e.ods_record_hash,
    CASE
      WHEN o.our_id IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
      WHEN try_cast(e.batch_id AS bigint) >= try_cast(o.batch_id AS bigint) AND coalesce(e.ods_record_hash, '') <> coalesce(o.record_hash, '') THEN 'UPDATE'
      ELSE 'NOOP'
    END AS cdc_action
  FROM enriched_dedup e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT o.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.our_id, o.source_system ORDER BY try_cast(o.batch_id AS bigint) DESC, coalesce(o.updated_at, o.created_at) DESC) AS dup_seq
    FROM ${catalog}.${ods_schema}.member o
  ) o ON o.our_id = e.our_id AND o.source_system <=> e.source_system AND o.dup_seq = 1
)
SELECT * FROM with_ods WHERE cdc_action <> 'NOOP'
) x WHERE cdc_action = 'INSERT'
